import json,os,urllib.request,urllib.error
from collections import Counter
KEY=os.environ.get("N8N_API_KEY","")
BASE="https://irynakarmazina.app.n8n.cloud/api/v1"
def get(path):
    r=urllib.request.Request(BASE+path,headers={"X-N8N-API-KEY":KEY})
    return json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=45).read().decode("utf-8","ignore"))
wfs=get("/workflows?limit=200").get("data",[])
names={w["id"]:w.get("name") for w in wfs}
active={w["id"]:w.get("active") for w in wfs}
cnt=Counter(); errc=Counter()
cursor=None; total=0; earliest=None; latest=None; pages=0
while pages<12:
    path="/executions?limit=250"+("&cursor="+cursor if cursor else "")
    try: d=get(path)
    except Exception as e: print("EXEC_ERR",str(e)[:80]); break
    for e in d.get("data",[]):
        wid=e.get("workflowId"); cnt[wid]+=1; total+=1
        stt=e.get("status") or ("error" if e.get("finished")==False else "")
        if stt=="error": errc[wid]+=1
        s=e.get("startedAt") or e.get("createdAt")
        if s:
            earliest=s if (earliest is None or s<earliest) else earliest
            latest=s if (latest is None or s>latest) else latest
    cursor=d.get("nextCursor"); pages+=1
    if not cursor: break
print("RETAINED executions:",total,"| pages",pages,"| ще є далі:",bool(cursor))
print("вікно:",(earliest or "?")[:19],"->",(latest or "?")[:19])
print("--- по воркфлоу (кількість | активний | помилок | назва) ---")
for wid,c in cnt.most_common():
    print(c,"|",("ON " if active.get(wid) else "off"),"| err",errc.get(wid,0),"|",names.get(wid,wid))
# active workflows with zero retained executions (still consume when they run)
zero=[names.get(w) for w in names if active.get(w) and cnt.get(w,0)==0]
if zero: print("активні без виконань у вибірці:",zero)
